title: Necropolis workshop tool (TOOL MORGUE row)
description: One meaningfully invokable forensic instrument harvested from Prometheus. A row records what the instrument IS and what has been MEASURED about it; it never records what the instrument PROVES about any grave. Status semantics: READY = imports, executes on a fixture, and has at least one accept AND one reject/differentiate control that was RUN by the Keeper (self_tests non-empty, last_verified_execution present). READY_WITH_CAVEAT = same but a named caveat limits evidentiary scope. NEEDS_DEPENDENCY = blocked by an uninstalled/unreachable dependency (dependency_status names it). NEEDS_ADAPTER = logic is sound but no stable invocation exists. NEEDS_VALIDATION = executes but no control has been run. HISTORICAL_ONLY = recovered from git history or a dead agent; characterised, not adopted. BROKEN = does not import or does not execute as documented (that is evidence, not a defect to fix). UNTRUSTED = executes and passes its own tests but a cheat defeated it. DUPLICATE = same logic as another row (duplicate_of names it).

source_commit.description: commit at which the instrument was read/characterised (git log -1 on current_path), or the last commit containing it for HISTORICAL_ONLY

dependency_status.description: MISSING = pip/binary absent here; UNREACHABLE = network/DB/host not reachable from the Keeper's host; HOST_LOCAL = present only on a named host

how.description: the exact command or test that was executed

artifact.description: repo-relative path of the result file, if any

evidentiary_scope.description: what a run of this instrument CAN establish

forbidden_inference.description: what a run of this instrument must NOT be read as establishing

necropolis_adapter.description: repo-relative path of the NECROPOLIS ADAPTER wrapping this instrument, if one was written

layer.description: which of the three layers the current_path IS

inspected.description: true only if the Keeper opened and read the main logic

x-status-rules.READY: self_tests must contain at least one ACCEPT-family kind (ACCEPT, SYNTHETIC_SIGNAL, PARITY, REPETITION) AND at least one REJECT-family kind (REJECT, CHEAT, SYNTHETIC_NULL, CORRUPT_INPUT, PERTURBATION, LAUNDERING), every self_test result PASS, last_verified_execution non-null, current_path non-null
x-status-rules.HISTORICAL_ONLY: historical_path required; current_path may be null
x-status-rules.UNTRUSTED: at least one self_test of kind CHEAT with result FAIL
